rics.description: CORPORATE PROFITS WITH IVA & CCADJ - NONFINANCIAL (AR)
rics.meaning: Nonfinancial corporate profits with inventory valuation and capital consumption adjustments — the cleanest cyclical profit measure in the NIPA accounts.
rics.how_to_use: Leading indicator for capex and hiring. Diverges from S&P 500 EPS (which is global + financial-heavy); useful as a domestic real-economy profit gauge. Compare to nonfinancial output to track margin trends.

rics.meaning: Personal consumption of consumer durables by households and non-profit institutions serving households (NPISH). Annual NIPA detail.
rics.how_to_use: Long-cycle gauge of durables stock formation (vehicles, furniture, appliances). Use the QoQ retail/durables prints for cycle timing; this annual line is for level/trend.
